name: pilot-development-verification-result
purpose: Provide a deterministic provider-independent result for development verification and release-candidate eligibility.

rules.pass: overall_status may be PASSED only when every required check is PASSED
rules.block: a required BLOCKED or FAILED check prevents release-candidate eligibility
rules.optional: optional checks do not veto promotion unless policy marks them required
rules.deployment: development verification must not invoke the deployment adapter
